answer: The role of the AI Office regarding FRIA tools, as described in arXiv 2501.14756, is to develop a questionnaire and an automated tool to facilitate deployers in complying with their obligations under the AI Act in a simplified manner. This includes creating a template for the questionnaire to reduce the administrative burden for deployers and to support the obligations outlined in the AI Act. The AI Office is responsible for ensuring that these tools assist with the FRIA process and help organizations meet their compliance requirements.
